decisions.question: What lifecycle disposition should apply to the three Owner-linked World tables on validated account erasure?

options.technicalImpact: Preserves Owner-bound semantics, removes direct personal linkage, aligns with no-archive first slice.
implementationImpact: add executable delete order before users row deletion
update account erasure topology execution plan

options.technicalImpact: Requires a new non-identifying schema/semantic model because current rows are directly Owner-scoped.
implementationImpact: prove retained state cannot relink to Owner
define why retained aggregate remains necessary

options.technicalImpact: Requires separate explicit legal/rights/security necessity; current product design has no technical requirement for retained identifiable World progression after account erasure.
implementationImpact: record separate authority and retention window

decisions.question: Should durable World progression state be included in Owner account export?

options.technicalImpact: Export progression events/provenance, owned items and resource spends in an Owner-scoped bounded representation.
Requires explicit documented reason for withholding Owner-linked product state.

decisions.question: What retention rule should apply while and after an account exists?

options.technicalImpact: Keep state while the account uses World; on validated account erasure apply the approved erasure disposition. No separate archive by default.
Requires a specific justified duration, purge scheduler, backup handling and user-facing disclosure.

decisions.question: How should legacy browser gamification/community state interact with G2?

options.technicalImpact: Never retro-reward localStorage counters. Preserve/remove legacy UI state only through its own explicit cutover.
Requires canonical server-side evidence for each Owner/event; localStorage alone is insufficient evidence and cannot grant resources.
